svg.title: pinstripe-diagonal
svg.desc: One lattice cell. A 45-degree band of the line y = x, half-width 26 measured along an axis, running corner to corner. The pattern is the periodic set |(y - x) mod 100| <= 26, so the two corner triangles that carry the neighbouring stripes have legs of exactly 26 — not 13, which is what they were, and which put a mean |dAlpha| of 68/255 across the cell's own wrap: a visible grid line down every card the tile is used on. tools/build-ink-index.mjs now measures the seam of every tile and refuses anything but 0. Rotate the whole lattice with uInkTile.w rather than authoring a second angle. Alpha is ink coverage. See INK-TILES-NOTICE.md.
